notes: Email verification unlocks multiplayer, challenges, the leaderboard and payouts. Solo quizzes and gauntlets stay open while you verify.
Phone verification has been retired: no SMS step.
Referral rewards now require a verified email and the existing 3-quiz / 2-day activity rule.
Money calls need an account that is at least 7 days old, plus a verified email.
Security: account limits, disposable-email blocking and challenge farming caps are enforced on the server.
